official_title: Form W-9: Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification (Rev. March 2024)

columns.format_notes: Line 1 entity or individual legal name exactly as shown on federal tax return.
Line 2 business name, trade name, or disregarded entity name if different from Line 1.
Maps to checkboxes c1_1[0..6] with PDF export values /1 (Individual/sole proprietor), /2 (C Corp), /3 (S Corp), /4 (Partnership), /5 (Trust/estate), /6 (LLC), /7 (Other).
Required when Tax_Classification is LLC: single letter C, S, or P.
Rev. March 2024 Line 3b checkbox (PDF export value /1 or /Off) for partnerships/trusts/LLCs taxed as partnerships with foreign partners/owners/beneficiaries.
Line 4 numeric code (1-13) if applicable; keep as text.
Line 4 letter code (A-M) for FATCA reporting exemption if applicable.
Line 5 number, street, and apt or suite number.
Line 6 city, state, and ZIP code; preserve leading-zero East Coast ZIPs (e.g., 02110, 07102) as text.
Optional requester block; frequently kept constant across all vendor rows.
Line 7 optional vendor or ERP account reference (e.g., QuickBooks vendor ID).
Helper column (EIN or SSN) telling merge scripts whether to populate f1_14/f1_15 (EIN) or f1_11/f1_12/f1_13 (SSN).
First 2 digits of Employer Identification Number (text-formatted to keep leading zeros).
Last 7 digits of Employer Identification Number (text-formatted to keep leading zeros).
Formatted XXX-XX-XXXX (strictly synthetic 000-00-000x in examples). Split on '-' into 3 comb boxes f1_11 (3), f1_12 (2), f1_13 (4), or leave blank for taxpayer completion.
